author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.83 shipped: Occupancy anomaly sensor on a room dwell model
summary: Occupancy anomaly sensor on a room dwell model
why: Operator wanted the sensor working but correct ('they need to be right'), sensor-only. The old Bayesian model counted arrivals not dwell (Study A scored 1% despite 20 h). Chose a per-room hour-of-week occupied-share model from environmental_data (already recorded every 5 min, 365-day retention) over patching the threshold. Built first and replayed after, per operator ('we forget these cards'): replay at 1800 s debounce gives median 0 fires/day, max 2 per room, 0 false fires in Study A weekdays, 47/47 rooms learned. Reviews A/B/C + a focused fourth pass; exit-row gap on three vacate paths fixed at the producer.
implications: Shipped BAYES-OCCUPANCY-ANOMALY-NEVER-EVALUATES-1 at v5.103.83; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.83.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: D0 replay (scripts/probes/occupancy_dwell_backtest.py --days 7) after a week live: G1-G4 still pass; any fires judged by a person

refs.release_notes:
- Room occupancy-anomaly sensor now evaluates, using each room's usual occupied share by hour and weekday/weekend (56 days of URA history); sensor only, no notification; 30-min debounce
- Exit row written on every room vacancy; occupied-time and occupancy % sensors pair entry/exit with a 12 h episode cap; today sensors refresh every 5 min
